operations.product_need: A flat department with an exact same-tenant roster is missing. Combine name/state and full roster replacement under one CAS rather than two mutable APIs.
operations.reuse_or_avoid: Reuse native Tenant/UserTenant identity and existing native member-picker APIs; do not create accounts/roles/org tree. UI presents the fixed tenant invalidation warning without claiming unavailable exact impact counts.

operations.product_need: Domain owner must choose a known department; tenant owner must reopen roster editing after refresh. One catalog returns names only to other active tenant members and roster/count only to tenant owner.
operations.reuse_or_avoid: Native tenant-member list is reused for the picker, but cannot represent department subsets. No separate department get/roster/list-members API.

operations.product_need: Explicit default-off shared-domain opt-in and emergency disable must be separate from existing model/parse policy.
operations.reuse_or_avoid: Frozen owner-only policy cannot gain fields or silently change access semantics. No generic policy engine.

operations.product_need: Create/update/disable one exact fixed-publication target subset with CAS. One set replaces separate create/update/delete operations.
operations.reuse_or_avoid: Reuse existing owner publication/typed target selectors; module is not a KnowledgeGroup or another index.

operations.product_need: Owner needs exact scope and grant metadata to edit/revoke after a refresh. Bundle the bounded grant list here. Its owner-only result includes current domain policy and current live grants; retained grant/audit history is not returned.
operations.reuse_or_avoid: No separate grant-list endpoint, source browser or audit query is needed for the first closure.

operations.product_need: Recipients need a Shared with me entry point filtered before SQL counts and output. It also returns current native owner module administrative summaries and owner-only sharing policy CAS state (including default0), not shared consumption privilege; this avoids separate module-list/policy-get endpoints.
operations.reuse_or_avoid: Existing ListKnowledgeDomains/Groups is frozen owner-only and must not expose shares by widening its predicate.

operations.product_need: Owner explicitly permits one named native user/module/mode/channel/expiry; S2 adds exact department subject. Immutable definition avoids mutable permissions-in-place.
operations.reuse_or_avoid: Native team membership is identity only; existing native dataset Use/Run is not a read-sharing grant.

operations.product_need: Owner must revoke one immutable grant immediately and invalidate later view/ref use.
operations.reuse_or_avoid: Cannot repurpose source archive/delete or tenant membership removal as grant revocation.

operations.product_need: Recipient explicitly creates a self credential from an active native web_and_mcp view, preserving its single grant and selected target subset.
operations.reuse_or_avoid: No new principal-selection API or recipient grant-list is needed. Native/API/model tokens are never borrowed.

operations.product_need: User can stop one leaked/unused bearer without removing the department grant.
operations.reuse_or_avoid: Existing API-token management has broader identity semantics and cannot be widened/reused.

operations.product_need: Safe metadata supports expiry/revocation and unknown first-mint delivery recovery; optional exact request key returns metadata only.
operations.reuse_or_avoid: Combine by-key metadata lookup with this list; no token retrieval/refresh/rotate endpoint.

operations.product_need: Resolve one current exact authorization view and show authorized metadata/readiness; choose delivery and mode in one call. Also return bounded per-target whole-unit counts so read-only users can select a first unit without search.
operations.reuse_or_avoid: Private immutable proof/row loaders are reusable. Existing0.2 inspect full-selection DTO and owner authentication cannot be returned to a restricted reader.

operations.product_need: Match only authorized whole rows and emit new scoped citations, count and stable ordering.
operations.reuse_or_avoid: Reuse query builder, DocEngine, ES and bound row-pair filter; keep old owner Use/Run guards. No new retrieval backend/model path.

operations.product_need: A new view/evidence identifier must be reauthorized on every fixed evidence read and output. One closed selector supports first read by view target/unit ordinal and later exact evidence ref; same operation/tool and read action only.
operations.reuse_or_avoid: Reuse immutable byte/hash/provenance validators after proper shared authorization; never fake owner session or emit old full context.

removed_from_initial18.resolution: Merged into setDepartment atomic complete roster CAS.
Bounded grant metadata embedded only in getModuleAdmin.
Native inspect explicitly requests delivery+mode and binds one qualifying grant; credential mint takes that view_id.
Server audit recording is required; a general audit-query UI/API is deferred. Initial Web shows safe grant/credential metadata and last use only.

stages.delivers: Explicit direct-user fixed-module sharing, safe scoped search/read and Web closure; no department subject or temporary bearer exposure yet.
stages.gate: Specific subject decision, owning code review and meaningful scoped tests/real synthetic SQL+ES/Web checks. This is a bounded development/product slice, not a claim that the entire0.3 candidate is complete.
stages.contract_handling: Expose only this declared user-only slice in an isolated synthetic acceptance environment. Department and credential operations remain unregistered. No client is promised final full0.3 until S2/S3 pass; no permanent alternate implementation or owner-token fallback.
stages.commit_checkpoint: After accepted stage evidence, normal project stage commit+push by Root-assigned Git owner under current human authorization; this task makes no Git writes.

stages.delivers: Exact department A/B mapping and grants, with live roster checks and coarse tenant epoch invalidation. Same S1 authorization/projection core.
stages.gate: S1 accepted plus department positive/negative/roster-race synthetic tests; no generic role hierarchy.
stages.commit_checkpoint: Separate reviewed stage commit+push after acceptance.

stages.delivers: One-time short-lived bearer delivery and revocation, exact named SDK/client interoperability for the same scoped service.
stages.gate: S2/core accepted, secret lifecycle and revoke/ref/cache tests, real isolated named SDK checks and Web handoff; no generated credential in this design task.
stages.commit_checkpoint: Separate reviewed stage commit+push after acceptance.

later_separate_decisions.subject: OAuth-only/automatic Agent onboarding
later_separate_decisions.requires: Choose an existing trusted AS/IdP and explicit OAuth resource metadata/audience/PKCE/client model. New exact candidate; not silently part of S3.

later_separate_decisions.subject: Node/byte ACL, dynamic head scopes, rich typed payload and attachments
later_separate_decisions.requires: New bounded provenance/projection/interface candidate and independent acceptance. Do not add for this first department/module closure.

decision_options.label: 按固定模块与具名Bearer方案分阶段推进
decision_options.consequence: Accept S1/S2/S3 scope, fixed-target granularity, typed summaries, stable lexical order and coarse credential renewal. Broad any-Agent OAuth onboarding remains later.

decision_options.label: 共享内核继续，凭据阶段先补OAuth候选
decision_options.consequence: S1/S2 can still proceed after decision; S3 transport not yet selected. Root first obtains chosen OAuth host/authorization-server constraints and presents a replacement exact S3 subject.

decision_mechanism: Root independent review first. Human decision binds a concrete subject-manifest raw SHA and selected option. This candidate is not implementation authorization and this task asks no open-ended user question.
stage_activation: S1/S2 are explicitly scoped isolated synthetic acceptance/development slices, with unimplemented later routes unregistered; they do not advertise a completed final0.3 interface or require a permanent alternate backend. External0.3 release/rollout is separate after all chosen stages and actual evidence. No general runtime phase/feature negotiation API is added.
command_persistence: Extend the existing access audit row for exactly seven mutation receipts and one unique actor+operation+key map; no new generic command API or table.
read_only: Read mode retained. Existing inspect+read close first access and multi-unit traversal. No silent upgrade to read_search and no fourth MCP tool.
